summary: update_contract::execute applied normalize_path but never re-validated empty/non-slash path. Fixed: validate_merged() runs the same invariants as ContractCreate::validate on the post-update contract.

update_contract with patch.group_name absent SILENTLY DETACHED contract from its group. Fixed: fetch current contract first, group_id only None on explicit Some(''), otherwise preserve current.group_id.
list_contracts group filter used resolve() (create-or-find). Fixed: new GroupRepo::find_by_name (no INSERT), list_contracts returns 404 NotFound for unknown group.
search_contract group filter used resolve(). Fixed at use-case level: search_contract::execute now uses find_by_name (no-INSERT), returns 404 NotFound.
list_contracts rejected empty group_name while create_contract silently dropped it. Fixed: list_contracts now treats empty group_name as 'no filter', mirroring create_contract.
update_contract didn't re-validate tag/summary/path. Fixed by same validate_merged() as BUG-001.
Race between load_contract and UPDATE returned silent success even when UPDATE matched 0 rows. Fixed: post-UPDATE COUNT check returns NotFound if 0.
HeaderValue::from_str().unwrap() in openapi.yml disposition. Fixed: unwrap_or_else fallback to 'attachment' static value.

Project page Group column always blank. Fixed: ContractSummary/SearchResult gain group_name: Option<String>, contract_repo_sqlite::list() LEFT JOINs groups, handlers.rs populates ContractRow.group, MCP tool JSON outputs include group.
Semantic-only search cards had empty method/path/summary. Fixed: post-hydration step in search_contract::execute calls find_by_id for any result with path=='' && summary=='', populates fields.
CSS classes .muted and .num referenced in HTML but missing from style.css. Fixed: added .muted { color: var(--muted); } and .num { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }.
UI template responses were served as text/plain instead of text/html; fixed and retested.
Fallback HTML error responses were served as text/plain instead of text/html; fixed and retested.
Web search suppressed project-not-found errors and returned a misleading 200 empty page; fixed and retested.
MCP accepted jsonrpc 1.0 and dispatched it as a JSON-RPC 2.0 request; fixed and retested.
MCP classified a structurally invalid envelope without method as a parse error; fixed and retested.

requirement: Code intent: admin user creation flow advertises flash=invalid redirect on validation failure (src/web/admin.rs:45, 137)
summary: POST /admin/users returned bare HTTP 400 (empty body) for a too-short password or unknown role instead of redirecting to /admin/users?flash=invalid. The friendly flash message the new admin template advertises ('Check the username and password (minimum 12 characters)') was therefore unreachable from the user-facing flow. Fixed: Role::parse and password::hash_password failures now share the flash=invalid redirect with the rest of the validation paths.

requirement: Project page header total_contracts and the rendered contract tree must agree (consistency between header and body)
summary: Project page handler dropped contracts with empty group_name from the rendered group tree while still counting them in the header's total_contracts. A project with one ungrouped contract would show 'Contracts (1)' and 'No contracts yet.' simultaneously, hiding the contract from the user. Found via Chrome DevTools Protocol UI flow test (UC-032). Fixed: handler now collects ungrouped contracts separately and renders them under a virtual 'Ungrouped' group at the top of the tree.

requirement: Authenticated pages must expose a working sign-out control (every user can end their session through the UI)
summary: The /logout endpoint and POST handler existed but no template ever rendered a sign-out form. Authenticated users had no way to end their session through the UI. Found via Chrome DevTools button-functionality test (BTN-012 'Logout works') and direct template inspection. Fixed: added a `data-logout` form to `templates/base.html` and `templates/docs/base_docs.html`; allowed the CSRF cookie to be read from JavaScript (it was previously HttpOnly, which is correct for the session cookie but wrong for the CSRF token that the logout form needs to read). The form's CSRF value is auto-populated by an inline script from `document.cookie`.
